verses.text: Then the Spirit led Jesus into the desert to be tempted by the devil.
After going without food for forty days and forty nights, Jesus was hungry.
The tempter came to him and said, "If you are the Son of God, tell these stones to become bread."
Jesus answered, "It is written: 'People do not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of God.'"
Then the devil took him to the holy city of Jerusalem and had him stand on the highest point of the temple.

"If you are the Son of God," he said, "throw yourself down. For it is written: 'He will command his angels to take care of you. They will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not hit your foot against a stone.'"
Jesus answered him, "It is also written: 'Do not put the Lord your God to the test.'"
Then the devil took him to a very high mountain. He showed him all the kingdoms of the world and all their greatness.
"I will give you all of this," he said, "if you will bow down and worship me."
Jesus said to him, "Go away, Satan! For it is written: 'Worship the Lord your God, and serve only him.'"
Then the devil left him, and angels came and took care of him.
When Jesus heard that John had been put in prison, he went back to Galilee.
He left Nazareth and went to live in Capernaum, a town by the lake, in the area of Zebulun and Naphtali.
This made come true what the prophet Isaiah had said:
"Land of Zebulun and land of Naphtali, along the road to the sea, on the other side of the Jordan, Galilee where people from other nations live,
the people who lived in darkness have seen a great light. A light has shone on those who lived in the land of the shadow of death."
From that time on Jesus began to preach. He said, "Turn away from your sins, because the kingdom of heaven is near."
As Jesus was walking beside the Sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers, Simon, who was called Peter, and his brother Andrew. They were throwing a net into the lake, because they were fishermen.
Jesus said to them, "Come and follow me, and I will teach you to fish for people."
Straight away they left their nets and followed him.
Going on from there, he saw two other brothers, James son of Zebedee and his brother John. They were in a boat with their father Zebedee, mending their nets. Jesus called them,
and straight away they left the boat and their father and followed him.
Jesus went all over Galilee, teaching in the synagogues and preaching the good news about the kingdom. He healed every kind of disease and illness among the people.

News about him spread all over Syria. People brought to him everyone who was ill with all kinds of diseases and pain. They brought people who had demons, people who had seizures and people who could not move, and he healed them.
Large crowds followed him from Galilee, from the Ten Towns, from Jerusalem, from Judea and from the other side of the Jordan River.
